notes:
{早|はや}く is the adverbial form of the i-adjective ⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧. It covers three related meanings: early (time), quickly (speed), and soon (desire for something to happen).

FORMS:
⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ → {早|はや}く (i-adjective → adverb by changing い to く)

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {早|はや}く: early or quickly (time-oriented — covers both meanings)
- ⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧: fast, at high speed (purely about speed)
In practice, {早|はや}く is used for both senses and is the more common spelling.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {早|はや}く⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: to wake up early
- {早|はや}く⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to go home early
- ⟦できるだけ→できるだけ：01289_dekirudake⟧{早|はや}く: as soon as possible
- {早|はや}く⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦になって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: get well soon

USAGE:
{早|はや}く! on its own works as an urging expression: "Hurry up!"
